title: A finite set with noncompact closed convex hull in a Hadamard space
summary: We show that there is a Hadamard space in which the closed convex hull of a set containing merely three points is noncompact, by providing an AI-generated construction. The seemingly innocuous problem of finding a compact or finite set with this property, or showing that none exists, was recorded by Gromov and periodically revisited by researchers in metric geometry, functional analysis, fixed-point theory, and geometric group theory.
